essence: Seat abiding, happily dived in lake.
Ka-class etc, great-lady etc, bound mothers.
In three, fourth oil-like to be poured.
Sunk, by own mind should enter.
In mothers, non-certainty joining, destroyed rises again.

rasa.justification: Seventeen injunctions-descriptions (attend, dive, make, watch, enter, pour) each landing in stillness — subdued wit, natural breath, even seeing. Vidhi as śānta's skeleton.

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is named; practice is described, not yet sealed.
sections.EXPLANATION: By wit subdued, being accomplished. Perfected, free-natured. As there, so elsewhere (continuity). Seed attending. Seat abiding, happily dived in lake. Own-measure making brings about. On wisdom perishing, birth perishing. Ka-class etc, great-lady etc, bound mothers. In three, the fourth oil-like to be poured (unbroken turya). Sunk, by own mind should enter. On breath coursing, even-seeing. In middle, inferior birthing. In mothers, on non-certainty joining, of destroyed, again rising. Śiva-equaled becomes. Body-course, vow. Talk, muttering. Giving, self-knowing.
sections.FUNCTION: Describes the practice arc: subdued, perfected, continuous, seeded, dived, made, perished, mothered, poured, entered, seen, birthed, risen, equaled, vowed, muttered, given.
sections.KEY TERMS: dhīvaśa (wit-subdued); turya (the fourth — oil-poured); bījāvadhāna (seed-attending); prāṇasamācāra (breath-coursing); mātṛkās (bound mothers); japa (all talk); dāna (all giving).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Practice described here is sealed by mantra-fruit and re-closing beyond.
